checks.details: The official form exposes first-degree sentence search and public comarca/vara autocomplete endpoints.

The form requires a valid CNJ number together with comarca, vara and judge identifiers; a bounded query without a matching process returned the authoritative empty table. It does not expose a general text-searchable corpus suitable for federation.

decision: Do not implement or count this route as TJPR CJPG. Keep it available as a future process-specific document lookup only; it is not equivalent to the public CJSG jurisprudence corpus.
safety: Only ordinary official HTTPS GET/POST requests were used with bounded parameters. No enumeration, credentials, CAPTCHA solving, session replay, or access-control circumvention was attempted.
